title: Dark Night: A True Batman Story TPB (Trade Paperback, DC/Vertigo 2016) Paul Dini
descriptionText:
Dark Night: A True Batman Story TPB (Trade Paperback, DC/Vertigo 2016) – Paul Dini & Eduardo Risso
Condition: Like New / Excellent
🦇 Description:
From Paul Dini, the Emmy Award–winning writer and co-creator of Batman: The Animated Series, comes one of the most personal and powerful graphic novels ever published by DC Comics. Illustrated by Eduardo Risso (100 Bullets), Dark Night: A True Batman Story tells a real-life tale of trauma, recovery, and resilience — and how the Dark Knight became a symbol of hope for the author himself.
⭐ Critical Acclaim:
“A masterpiece of biographical storytelling in the comics medium.” — Huffington Post
“One of the bravest, most vulnerable works of the medium in years.” — Paste Magazine
“A powerful tale of healing and redemption.” — Neil Gaiman
📖 Story Summary (from back cover):
In the 1990s, Paul Dini was a celebrated writer on Batman: The Animated Series. Then one night, his life changed forever when he was violently attacked and left badly injured. As he struggled with recovery — physically and emotionally — Dini found himself haunted by visions of Batman and his rogues’ gallery, each representing pieces of his psyche as he fought to rebuild his confidence and creativity.
A unique and deeply human look at the enduring power of stories and superheroes, this book redefines what a Batman story can be.
🖋️ Details:
Writer: Paul Dini
Artist: Eduardo Risso
Publisher: DC / Vertigo Comics
Release Year: 2016
ISBN: 978-1-4012-7136-7
Cover Price: $16.99 USD
Format: Softcover / Trade Paperback
Genre: Autobiographical, Psychological, Superhero
📸 Condition Notes:
Excellent, gently handled copy.
Cover glossy and clean, with sharp corners.
Spine tight, no creases.
Interior pages clean and bright — no writing or damage (see photos for details).
